doc:
`Polynomial R` is the type of univariate polynomials over `R`,
denoted as `R[X]` within the `Polynomial` namespace.

Polynomials should be seen as (semi-)rings with the additional constructor `X`.
The embedding from `R` is called `C`.

doc: The set of all `n` such that `X^n` has a non-zero coefficient.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → Finset ℕ
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (q : ℕ →₀ R), Polynomial.support (AddMonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff q) = q.support
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.support 0 = ∅

statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → ℕ → R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {m n : ℕ} {a b : R},

doc:
`C a` is the constant polynomial `a`.
`C` is provided as a ring homomorphism.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → R →+* Polynomial R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] ⦃a : R⦄, (Polynomial.monomial 0) a = Polynomial.C a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C 0 = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C 1 = 1
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) [inst_1 : n.AtLeastTwo], Polynomial.C (OfNat.ofNat n) = OfNat.ofNat n
∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C (a * b) = Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.C b
∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C (a + b) = Polynomial.C a + Polynomial.C b

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : SMulZeroClass S R] (s : S) (r : R),
  s • Polynomial.C r = Polynomial.C (s • r)
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C (a ^ n) = Polynomial.C a ^ n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), Polynomial.C ↑n = ↑n

∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R],
  Polynomial.C a * (Polynomial.monomial n) b = (Polynomial.monomial n) (a * b)

∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R],
  (Polynomial.monomial n) a * Polynomial.C b = (Polynomial.monomial n) (a * b)

doc: `X` is the polynomial variable (aka indeterminate).
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], (Polynomial.monomial 1) 1 = Polynomial.X
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.monomial n) 1 = Polynomial.X ^ n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.X = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] (a : R), Polynomial.X ≠ Polynomial.C a

doc: `X` commutes with everything, even when the coefficients are noncommutative.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, Polynomial.X * p = p * Polynomial.X
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ}, Polynomial.X ^ n * p = p * Polynomial.X ^ n

Prefer putting constants to the left of `X ^ n`.

doc:
Prefer putting constants to the left of `X ^ n`.

This lemma is the loop-avoiding `simp` version of `X_pow_mul_assoc`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ} (r : R),
  p * Polynomial.X ^ n * Polynomial.C r = p * Polynomial.C r * Polynomial.X ^ n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), Commute Polynomial.X p
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), Commute (Polynomial.X ^ n) p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) r * Polynomial.X = (Polynomial.monomial (n + 1)) r

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (r : R) (k : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) r * Polynomial.X ^ k = (Polynomial.monomial (n + k)) r

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (r : R),

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (k n : ℕ) (r : R),

∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} {m n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], ((Polynomial.monomial n) a).coeff m = if n = m then a else 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (c : R), ((Polynomial.monomial n) c).coeff n = c
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {m n : ℕ} (c : R), m ≠ n → ((Polynomial.monomial n) c).coeff m = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff 0) n = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ}, (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff 1) n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.X.coeff 0 = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.X.coeff 1 = 1
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], ((Polynomial.monomial (n + 1)) a).coeff 0 = 0
∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.X.coeff n = if 1 = n then 1 else 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 1 → Polynomial.X.coeff n = 0
∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, n ∈ p.support ↔ p.coeff n ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, n ∉ p.support ↔ p.coeff n = 0
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], (Polynomial.C a).coeff n = if n = 0 then a else 0
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R], (Polynomial.C a).coeff 0 = a
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} {n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], n ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a).coeff n = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {r : R} {n : ℕ}, (Polynomial.C r).coeff (n + 1) = 0
∀ {R : Type u} {m n : ℕ} [inst : Semiring R], (↑m).coeff n = ↑(if n = 0 then m else 0)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (a : ℕ) [inst_1 : a.AtLeastTwo], (OfNat.ofNat a).coeff 0 = OfNat.ofNat a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (a n : ℕ) [inst_1 : a.AtLeastTwo], (OfNat.ofNat a).coeff (n + 1) = 0
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ}, Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n = (Polynomial.monomial n) a
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X = (Polynomial.monomial 1) a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Function.Injective ⇑Polynomial.C
∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C a = Polynomial.C b ↔ a = b
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C a = 0 ↔ a = 0
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.C a ≠ 0 ↔ a ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Subsingleton (Polynomial R) ↔ Subsingleton R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, p ≠ q → Nontrivial R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], (∀ (f g : Polynomial R), f = g) ↔ ∀ (a b : R), a = b

doc: Monomials generate the additive monoid of polynomials.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], AddSubmonoid.closure {p | ∃ n a, p = (Polynomial.monomial n) a} = ⊤

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddZeroClass M] {f g : Polynomial R →+ M},
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R), f ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) = g ((Polynomial.monomial n) a)) → f = g

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddZeroClass M] {f g : Polynomial R →+ M},
  f = g ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R), f ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) = g ((Polynomial.monomial n) a)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddZeroClass M] {f g : Polynomial R →+ M},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), f.comp (Polynomial.monomial n).toAddMonoidHom = g.comp (Polynomial.monomial n).toAddMonoidHom) → f = g

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddZeroClass M] {f g : Polynomial R →+ M},
  f = g ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), f.comp (Polynomial.monomial n).toAddMonoidHom = g.comp (Polynomial.monomial n).toAddMonoidHom

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {f g : Polynomial R →ₗ[R] M}, f = g ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), f ∘ₗ Polynomial.monomial n = g ∘ₗ Polynomial.monomial n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {M : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {f g : Polynomial R →ₗ[R] M}, (∀ (n : ℕ), f ∘ₗ Polynomial.monomial n = g ∘ₗ Polynomial.monomial n) → f = g
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], 0 = 1 → ∀ (p : Polynomial R), p = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) {a : R}, a ≠ 0 → ((Polynomial.monomial n) a).support = {n}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (a : R), ((Polynomial.monomial n) a).support ⊆ {n}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {a : R}, a ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C a).support = {0}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (a : R), (Polynomial.C a).support ⊆ {0}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {c : R}, c ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X).support = {1}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (c : R), (Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X).support ⊆ {1}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) {c : R}, c ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X ^ n).support = {n}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (c : R), (Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.X ^ n).support ⊆ {n}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (k m : ℕ) (x y : R),
  (Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X ^ k + Polynomial.C y * Polynomial.X ^ m).support ⊆ {k, m}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), Polynomial.X ^ n = (Polynomial.monomial n) 1
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ}, a • Polynomial.X ^ n = (Polynomial.monomial n) a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.X ^ n).support = {n}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], 1 = 0 → Polynomial.X.support = ∅
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R], Polynomial.X.support = {1}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → ∀ {i j : ℕ}, (Polynomial.monomial i) a = (Polynomial.monomial j) a ↔ i = j

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {k l m n : ℕ} {u v : R},
  u ≠ 0 →
    v ≠ 0 →
      (Polynomial.C u * Polynomial.X ^ k + Polynomial.C v * Polynomial.X ^ l =
          Polynomial.C u * Polynomial.X ^ m + Polynomial.C v * Polynomial.X ^ n ↔
        k = m ∧ l = n ∨ u = v ∧ k = n ∧ l = m ∨ u + v = 0 ∧ k = l ∧ m = n)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial R), ↑n * p = n • p

doc: Summing the values of a function applied to the coefficients of a polynomial
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → {S : Type u_1} → [AddCommMonoid S] → Polynomial R → (ℕ → R → S) → S

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ p.support, f n (p.coeff n)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {p : Polynomial R} (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → ∀ {s : Finset ℕ}, p.support ⊆ s → p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ s, f n (p.coeff n)

doc: Expressing the product of two polynomials as a double sum.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p * q = ∑ i ∈ p.support, q.sum fun j a => (Polynomial.monomial (i + j)) (p.coeff i * a)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S), Polynomial.sum 0 f = 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {n : ℕ} (a : R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  f n 0 = 0 → ((Polynomial.monomial n) a).sum f = f n a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {a : R} {β : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] {f : ℕ → R → β},
  f 0 0 = 0 → (Polynomial.C a).sum f = f 0 a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {f : ℕ → R → S},
  f 1 0 = 0 → Polynomial.X.sum f = f 1 1

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p q : Polynomial R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → (∀ (a : ℕ) (b₁ b₂ : R), f a (b₁ + b₂) = f a b₁ + f a b₂) → (p + q).sum f = p.sum f + q.sum f

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_add`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f g : ℕ → R → S),
  p.sum (f + g) = p.sum f + p.sum g

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_add'`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f g : ℕ → R → S),
  (p.sum fun n x => f n x + g n x) = p.sum f + p.sum g

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_smul_index'` for a version using `smul` on the RHS.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (b : R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → (b • p).sum f = p.sum fun n a => f n (b * a)

doc: See also `Polynomial.sum_smul_index` for a version using multiplication on the RHS.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst_1 : DistribSMul T R] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid S]
  (p : Polynomial R) (b : T) (f : ℕ → R → S), (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → (b • p).sum f = p.sum fun n a => f n (b • a)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] [inst_2 : DistribSMul T S]
  (p : Polynomial R) (b : T) (f : ℕ → R → S), b • p.sum f = p.sum fun n a => b • f n a
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => (Polynomial.monomial n) a) = p
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n) = p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {motive : Polynomial R → Prop} (p : Polynomial R),
  (∀ (a : R), motive (Polynomial.C a)) →
    (∀ (p q : Polynomial R), motive p → motive q → motive (p + q)) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R),
          motive (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n) → motive (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ (n + 1))) →
        motive p

doc:
To prove something about polynomials,
it suffices to show the condition is closed under taking sums,
and it holds for monomials.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {motive : Polynomial R → Prop} (p : Polynomial R),
  (∀ (p q : Polynomial R), motive p → motive q → motive (p + q)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : R), motive ((Polynomial.monomial n) a)) → motive p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  Polynomial.support (AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p) = p.support.erase n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) (p.coeff n) + AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p = p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n i : ℕ),
  (AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p).coeff i = if i = n then 0 else p.coeff i
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {n : ℕ} {a : R}, AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) = 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R),
  ⇑(AddMonoidAlgebra.update n a p).coeff = Function.update (⇑p.coeff) n a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R) (i : ℕ),
  (AddMonoidAlgebra.update n a p).coeff i = if i = n then a else p.coeff i

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) {n i : ℕ} (a : R),
  i ≠ n → (AddMonoidAlgebra.update n a p).coeff i = p.coeff i

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.update n 0 p = AddMonoidAlgebra.erase n p

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R) [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  Polynomial.support (AddMonoidAlgebra.update n a p) = if a = 0 then p.support.erase n else insert n p.support

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  Polynomial.support (AddMonoidAlgebra.update n 0 p) = p.support.erase n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → Polynomial.support (AddMonoidAlgebra.update n a p) = insert n p.support

doc: The finset of nonzero coefficients of a polynomial.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → Finset R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.coeffs 0 = ∅
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {c : R}, c ∈ p.coeffs ↔ ∃ n ∈ p.support, c = p.coeff n

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {s : Set R},
  ↑p.coeffs ⊆ s ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.coeff n ∈ s

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {s : Finset R},
  p.coeffs ⊆ s ↔ ∀ (n : ℕ), p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.coeff n ∈ s
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.coeffs 1 ⊆ {1}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} {n : ℕ}, p.coeff n ≠ 0 → p.coeff n ∈ p.coeffs
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.coeffs = ∅ ↔ p = 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.coeffs.Nonempty ↔ p ≠ 0
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) {c : R}, c ≠ 0 → ((Polynomial.monomial n) c).coeffs = {c}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (-p).coeff n = -p.coeff n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (p q : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), (p - q).coeff n = p.coeff n - q.coeff n
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (n : ℕ) (a : R), (Polynomial.monomial n) (-a) = -(Polynomial.monomial n) a

∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Ring R] (n : ℕ),
  (Polynomial.monomial n) (a - b) = (Polynomial.monomial n) a - (Polynomial.monomial n) b
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] {p : Polynomial R}, (-p).support = p.support
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.C ↑n = ↑n
∀ {R : Type u} {a : R} [inst : Ring R], Polynomial.C (-a) = -Polynomial.C a
∀ {R : Type u} {a b : R} [inst : Ring R], Polynomial.C (a - b) = Polynomial.C a - Polynomial.C b
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [Nontrivial R], Polynomial.X ≠ 0

doc:
See also `Polynomial.isCancelMulZero_iff`: in order for `R[X]` to have cancellative
multiplication (stronger than `NoZeroDivisors` in general, but equivalent if `R` is a ring),
`R` must have both cancellative multiplication and cancellative addition.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], NoZeroDivisors (Polynomial R) ↔ NoZeroDivisors R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : DivisionSemiring R] (q : ℚ≥0) (f : Polynomial R), q • f = Polynomial.C ↑q * f
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : DivisionRing R] (a : ℚ) (f : Polynomial R), a • f = Polynomial.C ↑a * f
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Nontrivial (Polynomial R) ↔ Nontrivial R

doc: The map sending a collection of roots into a polynomial, as a morphism.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → AddChar (Multiset R) (Polynomial R)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (s : Multiset R),
  Polynomial.ofMultiset s = (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) s).prod
